# FocusFlow PRD

Status: Draft

## Product

FocusFlow is a web application that helps freelance designers plan focused work sessions.

## Users

Freelance designers who work from home.

## MVP

- Email sign-up
- Create a task
- Start a focus timer
- Weekly progress screen
- Paid Pro plan

## Pricing

Pro will cost either $8 or $12 per month. The final price has not been selected.

## Data

Timer history and task names are stored. The retention period and account-deletion behavior have not been decided.

## Payments

A payment provider will be selected later. Refunds should be “reasonable.”

## Success

The product should feel simple and help users focus more.
